title: Vampire Vape Rhubarb Crumble 10ml E-Liquid
description: The Rhubarb Crumble E-Liquid from Vampire Vape is a rich and comforting dessert classic with the fresh tangy taste of ripe rhubarb paired with a light, buttery biscuit base. A springtime twist on an autumn favourite, this delicious E-Liquid is sweet and tart, light and comforting all at once. Making this Vampire Vape Rhubarb Crumble E-Liquid a great addition to any dessert lovers E-Liquid collection. This E-Liquid from Vampire Vape offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing maximum flavour and satisfying clouds. Please note: that the 3mg nicotine strength contains 50VG/50PG while 3mg, 6mg, 12mg & 18mg nicotine strengths contain 40VG/60PG. They are versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits , pen-vape kits and pod kits. If you love this delicious Vampire Vape E-Liquid 10ml, then why not check out the other equally moreish flavours from their collection. They have a multitude of delicious flavours to choose from to suit any vaper’s flavour requirements. Go ahead and try out their juicy fruit flavours, refreshing beverage, sweet bakery, confectionary and dessert flavours or even their classic Mint/Menthol and tobacco flavours.
